mechanism: Celecoxib (CYP3A4/2C9 substrate) may increase albendazole levels through CYP3A4 inhibition, while albendazole induces CYP3A4 potentially reducing celecoxib efficacy; both drugs carry hepatotoxicity risk with concurrent use.
action: Monitor liver function tests periodically; use lowest effective celecoxib dose; consider alternative NSAIDs or analgesics if prolonged albendazole therapy required.
